dedupe_keys.name: austrian annual material stocks population and employment 1985 2018

description: These maps reconstruct annual material stocks, population and employment across Austria from 1985 to 2018. Humboldt University Berlin, BOKU Vienna, Trier University and University of Greifswald combine recent stock maps, census information and Landsat imagery. Thirty-metre rasters represent buildings, roads, railways and other infrastructure, with thirty-four annual bands in each tile. Zenodo supplies compressed GeoTIFF files, GDAL VRT mosaics and a state lookup in a freely available CC BY 4.0 deposit. The projection is EPSG:3035. Material mass is in tonnes; population and employment values must be divided by one hundred to recover counts. Reconstruction and spatial allocation assumptions are limitations for interpretation as individually observed assets or people. Modellers could simulate infrastructure-stock growth and changing service demand. data-material-stock-maps-10m-buildings-infrastructure contains the finer snapshot baseline, while model-odym provides a related stock-flow environment. The annual layers are a distinct derived product. No raster archive was downloaded or cell value inspected.
